text: AI is no longer science fiction.
It's the quiet engine behind faster diagnoses, safer transport, and personalized learning.
It helps us spot patterns humans miss, automate repetitive work, and free time for creativity.
We must build AI responsibly—with transparency, fairness, and human oversight.
Used wisely, AI amplifies human potential.
Ignored or misused, it widens gaps.
Our choices decide whether it serves everyone.
